adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the loop `usernames.split(",").each do |username|; if user = User.find_by_username(username); group.add(user); end; end` will indeed ignore unknown usernames and still return `success_json` as long as `group.save` succeeds. The diff shows no feedback mechanism (no error/partial-success reporting) to tell the client which usernames failed to resolve, so partial adds can be silently masked. This is a concrete, diff-grounded API/UX concern rather than a clearly incorrect behavior (the prior incremental add behavior also allowed silent success for non-existent users, per removed tests), so it’s not strictly a verifiable defect.
